analysis.title: Editorial Chicago Transit Campaign
analysis.notes: A restrained urban campaign interface combines large Chicago photography with a crisp white card system, compact navigation, metrics, and categorized content. The contrast between editorial serif display type and functional sans-serif UI creates a polished, approachable presentation.
analysis.heroPrompt: Wide editorial cityscape photograph at blue hour, viewed from an elevated downtown perspective, with a dense cluster of modern skyscrapers under dramatic blue-gray clouds. Cool steel, slate, and muted amber tones, subtle atmospheric haze, crisp architectural detail, and a cinematic but realistic documentary feel. Compose the skyline with strong verticals and open sky for generous headline space, using soft contrast and restrained color grading suitable for a refined urban advertising landing page. No text, logos, signage, or recognizable brands.
